prompt: You are in a checkout of the Python library httpx. Using only the files in this repository, answer all four parts below. Part B: About redirect handling in the sync and async clients: (1) the line number in httpx/_client.py of the line that raises TooManyRedirects (the line containing the raise statement); (2) the HTTP status codes (numbers) for which a redirect can change the request method to GET, as a comma separated list; (3) the request headers that are removed when the redirect switches the method to GET, as a comma separated list; (4) the one request header that is removed on every redirect regardless of origin or method. Part C: (1) the CHUNK_SIZE, as a plain integer, that httpx uses when reading file-like request content; (2) the content-encoding names registered in the decoder mapping in httpx/_decoders.py (every key written in that mapping, including any that may be removed at runtime), as a comma separated list; (3) the line number in httpx/_content.py on which the function encode_request is defined (the def line); (4) the name of the constant in the URL parsing module that limits the length of a URL. Part D: (1) how many names are listed in __all__ in httpx/__init__.py; (2) the default timeout in seconds of DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_CONFIG; (3) the default max_connections of DEFAULT_LIMITS; (4) the default max_keepalive_connections of DEFAULT_LIMITS. Do not modify any files. This is a large task with independent parts. Delegate the parts to sub-agents with invoke_agent (agent_name "code-puppy"), giving each sub-agent everything it needs in its prompt, then check and combine their results yourself.
